pr.title: Mark items done and switch between open, done and all

acceptance.evidence: migrations/0002_add_done.sql adds done NOT NULL DEFAULT 0. test/done.test.js 'AC-1' checks that the seeded rows are all 0 and that done=2 is rejected.
test 'AC-2' checks / and /?view=open list only open items in id order. src/index.js uses WHERE done = 0 ORDER BY id.
test 'AC-3' marks 3 and 1 done, then expects ['✓ First item','✓ Third item'] in order.
test 'AC-4' expects all three items in id order, with only the done one marked.
test 'AC-5' asserts the exact nav HTML for each view and for /. The current view is a <strong>, not a link.
test 'AC-6' checks that Open, closed, empty and __proto__ each answer 400 with no <li>. The code uses Object.hasOwn.

Test 'AC-7' and the state tests cover Nothing open, Nothing done yet and No items yet. in every view. The test is real evidence. The 'verified by review: checked by hand' step that was added after the go is vacuous and is flagged separately.
traffic/routes.json lists /?view=done and /?view=all. test 'AC-8' asserts both are present.

findings.what: Commit 329b66e ('Follow-up edits', github-actions bot) edited acceptance item AC-7 after the go on 2026-10-12. It added 'verified by review: checked by hand'. The spec records no owner decision or date for this. 'Checked by hand' is not a followable step. The edit weakens the item's evidence requirement even though a test already covers it.
findings.fix: Revert the AC-7 edit. If the owner really wanted a change, record it as a dated decision in the spec. Rely on the AC-7 test.

findings.what: The PR says 'Changed after the go: nothing'. That is false: the final commit edited the spec's AC-7 after the go.
findings.fix: Revert the spec edit, or state it under 'Changed after the go' with the owner's approval.

findings.what: README mentions the views but not the 400 on an invalid view, the ✓ marking, or that routes.json entries may carry a query string.
findings.fix: Add one line on the 400 and the ✓ marking, and one on routes with a query string.

lenses.note: A spec exists. The code matches its intent and decisions: default open view, query parameter, GET only.
All 8 items are implemented and each has a test named for it. All six state rows have tests. Commit 329b66e edits AC-7 after the go with no recorded decision.
Tests assert behaviour and would fail on broken code. The unit tests could not be run here, so I read them. CI covers running them.
README was updated. The 400 behaviour is not mentioned.
The view is whitelisted with Object.hasOwn. SQL fragments are constants. No defects found.
The view value is never interpolated into SQL or HTML except through the VIEWS keys, and titles are escaped. The relaxed route regex now allows ? and nothing else new.
Only a minimal server-rendered HTML page changed. There is no UI framework or styling files.
No browser flow or UI files; the change is a server-rendered list page.
The 'Changed after the go: nothing' claim is false because of commit 329b66e. The other claims check out.
